profiles.name: Apples
profiles.specificity: Whole fresh apples. Temperature targets use Golden Delicious as the reference cultivar; other cultivars may differ.

needs_fridge.basis: FoodKeeper (Apples) lists pantry storage of 3 weeks from purchase, so a household fridge is not required.

days_usable_cold.basis: FoodKeeper (Apples): refrigerator 4 to 6 weeks from purchase, at 7 days per week.

days_usable_room.basis: FoodKeeper (Apples): pantry 3 weeks from purchase, at 7 days per week.

transport_temperature.basis: UC Davis: optimum 0 C plus or minus 1 C, 90-95% RH, freezing at -1.7 C; the sheet lists no chilling injury. Cold is the optimum, not a requirement, because FoodKeeper gives 3 weeks at pantry temperature.

condition_grade.assumption: HarvestNet's proposed grade categories (docs/MVP_DESIGN.md section 5). The grade of an actual lot is the donor's evidence, not part of the profile.

units.assumption: Accepted units per docs/MVP_DESIGN.md section 5. Pounds are the base unit. Case net weight varies by pack, so none is stored here; the donor must state it on the surplus offer.

profiles.name: Romaine lettuce
profiles.specificity: Whole romaine heads (the UC Davis sheet also covers loose-leaf lettuce).

needs_fridge.basis: FoodKeeper (Lettuce: iceberg, romaine) gives refrigerator storage only, with no pantry time. UC Davis: romaine begins to yellow within 1-2 days at ambient temperature.

days_usable_cold.basis: FoodKeeper (Lettuce: iceberg, romaine): refrigerator 1 to 2 weeks from purchase. UC Davis is consistent: about 14 days at 5 C, about 21 days near 0 C.

days_usable_room.basis: UC Davis: romaine and dark green leafy lettuces begin to yellow within 1-2 days at ambient temperature.

transport_temperature.basis: UC Davis: storing near 0 C is required to optimize life (about 21 days); about 14 days at 5 C; >95% RH; freeze damage below -0.2 C; yellowing does not generally occur at 10 C or lower.

condition_grade.assumption: HarvestNet's proposed grade categories (docs/MVP_DESIGN.md section 5). The grade of an actual lot is the donor's evidence, not part of the profile.

units.assumption: Accepted units per docs/MVP_DESIGN.md section 5. Pounds are the base unit. Case net weight varies by pack, so none is stored here; the donor must state it on the surplus offer.

profiles.name: Potatoes
profiles.specificity: Whole fresh table potatoes. Temperature target is from the UC Davis early-crop sheet (table use); household times are FoodKeeper's general potato entry.

needs_fridge.basis: FoodKeeper (Potatoes): pantry storage is 'the recommended storage method for whole potatoes'.

days_usable_cold.basis: FoodKeeper (Potatoes): refrigerator 1 to 2 weeks from purchase, with a note that refrigeration can darken them on cooking and make them taste sweet.

days_usable_room.basis: FoodKeeper (Potatoes): pantry 1 to 2 months from purchase, converted at 30 days per month. UC Davis notes immature early-crop potatoes keep less well (good quality for 3-5 weeks at optimum).

transport_temperature.basis: UC Davis (early crop): table use 7 C at 98% RH; freezing injury begins at -0.8 C; storage near 0 C for a few weeks may cause chilling discoloration in some varieties (no threshold given, so none is stored). Not cold-required, because FoodKeeper recommends pantry storage.

condition_grade.assumption: HarvestNet's proposed grade categories (docs/MVP_DESIGN.md section 5). The grade of an actual lot is the donor's evidence, not part of the profile.

units.assumption: Accepted units per docs/MVP_DESIGN.md section 5. Pounds are the base unit. Sack net weight varies, so none is stored here; the donor must state it on the surplus offer.

profiles.name: Tomatoes
profiles.specificity: Whole ripe tomatoes (firm-ripe, USDA color stage 6, or riper). Mature-green tomatoes would need their own profile.

needs_fridge.basis: FoodKeeper (Tomatoes): 'Refrigeration may affect flavor; USDA recommends pantry storage.'

days_usable_cold.basis: Not recommended, so no cold life is given. FoodKeeper lists no refrigerator time for whole tomatoes and recommends pantry storage. UC Davis: chilling sensitive below 10 C if held longer than 2 weeks, or at 5 C longer than 6-8 days.

days_usable_room.basis: FoodKeeper (Tomatoes): pantry 'until ripe, then 7 days'. Counted from ripe, which matches this profile's maturity.

transport_temperature.basis: UC Davis: firm-ripe (USDA color stage 6) 7-10 C for 3-5 days; chilling sensitive below 10 C if longer than 2 weeks, or at 5 C longer than 6-8 days; freezing injury begins at -1 C. A short refrigerated trip is not by itself unsuitable (ADR 0003): exposure time matters.

condition_grade.assumption: HarvestNet's proposed grade categories (docs/MVP_DESIGN.md section 5). The grade of an actual lot is the donor's evidence, not part of the profile.

units.assumption: Accepted units per docs/MVP_DESIGN.md section 5. Pounds are the base unit. Case net weight varies by pack, so none is stored here; the donor must state it on the surplus offer.
